descriptors.name: openthread-bootloader-storage-internal-single
descriptors.label: Bootloader - SoC Internal Storage (single image on 1MB device)
descriptors.description: This sample configuration of the Gecko bootloader, intended for use with OpenThread package app workspaces, configures the bootloader to use the internal main flash to store firmware update images. The storage configuration is set up to store a single firmware update image at a time, in a single storage slot. The storage slot is configured to start at address 0x84000 (or 0x8084000 for device with 0x8000000 flash base), and have a size of 448 kB. This can be configured on the "Storage" tab.
